why: Size the watchdog timeout from measurement. The audit flagged that CpuAdamW.step moves ~3.8 GiB over PCIe and does single-threaded fp32 math over 314,618,880 elements per update, 105 updates per attempt, against a 2400 s worker ceiling.
what_this_is_not: No model weights were loaded. No forward/backward ran. No optimizer step touched a real parameter. Synthetic zero tensors at the real tail-20 shapes only.

projection.note: Optimizer cost only. Excludes model load, asset hashing, parameter_digest, forward/backward, probe generation and checkpoint writes.

conclusion: The optimizer is affordable inside the approved 2400 s worker ceiling; it is not the binding constraint. Remaining unknowns are measured by running the authorized qualify phase next.
